label: Integrated Buddhist Noble Truths and cessation of desire into Western metaphysics
Parfit explicitly identified his reductionism with Buddhist Anatta (no-self)
Engaged with Buddhist dialectics and the doctrine of non-self (Anatta) to formulate orthodox non-dual Advaita Vedanta (Atman is Brahman)
Systematized the Buddha's core insights of Pratītyasamutpāda (dependent origination) and Anatta into the radical dialectic of Madhyamaka emptiness
